summary: Round r1 (restricted network). The session's web-search budget was exhausted during 17A and every data/reference host tested (mofa.gov.np, bimstec.org, tadb.unescap.org, wikipedia) is blocked, so no China-specific document-level URL could be located; ten leads are recorded (MoFA Nepal, MOFCOM, Nepal customs and its FY2022/23 trade book, NTIP agreement register, NITDB, UN Comtrade mirror data, World Bank CEM 2025, and ICIMOD's 2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa flood note). Q1 (Chinese policies governing Tibet-Nepal border trade and connectivity): six watchlist areas are defined (transit transport agreement and protocol, BRI framework(s), cross-border railway study, northern border-port operations, China's LDC tariff treatment and post-graduation fate, TAR border-trade rules); instruments are named as documents to locate and all statuses are pending. Q2 (status of connectivity frameworks): a six-row status table is set up with evidence requirements; no status is asserted. No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: Q1: Chinese and bilateral instruments governing Tibet-Nepal border trade and connectivity are listed in specific.policy_watchlist; texts not retrieved and statuses unassigned.
findings.note: Requires document-level URLs from MoFA Nepal, MOFCOM, Chinese MFA and TAR authorities; locate in r2 when search/network is available.

findings.claim: Q2: Documented status of each bilateral connectivity framework (transit transport, BRI, Trans-Himalayan network, railway, border ports, power) is pending.
Nepal trade with China by customs office (northern points vs overseas/other routes) for FY2022/23 onward.
findings.note: Customs FY trade books and monthly office-level statistics (17B-L03, L04).

findings.claim: China-reported trade with Nepal (mirror data), calendar year, to compare with Nepal customs.
findings.note: Comtrade reporter China, partner Nepal, HS2, latest years; differences due to CIF/FOB, timing, transit attribution and FY-vs-CY must be documented, not netted.

findings.claim: Dates and duration of 2026 northern border-crossing disruption linked to the Kyirong-Rasuwa flood.
findings.note: ICIMOD note (17B-L07) establishes the event; closure/reopening dates require customs or MoFA notices. Relevant to S05/S10; escalate to 15/28 once verified.

findings.claim: China's tariff treatment of Nepal's exports and conditions after LDC graduation.
findings.note: Announcement text and coverage; coordinate with 26B/undesa_ldc on graduation timing.

findings.claim: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
Announced connectivity projects are carried in scenarios only as options conditional on implementing records; they contribute no capacity to baseline transit or trade until evidenced.

data_gaps: No document-level lead for any Nepal-China agreement text (transit transport agreement/protocol, BRI framework(s), railway study agreements) - search budget exhausted and hosts blocked.
China customs (GACC) data on trade with Nepal - not in source catalog (see 16A).
TAR border-trade regulations and border-port operating notices.
Closure/reopening records for northern crossings, including 2026 events.
MOFCOM/Customs Tariff Commission announcement on LDC zero-tariff treatment and applicability after graduation.
Project-level status (financing, construction) for BRI-listed projects in Nepal (MoF/IBN).

assumptions.text: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
Northern-route capacity enters scenarios only via evidenced operating status; announced projects are options, not baseline.
Chinese statistics are calendar-year; Nepal customs are Nepal FY; mirror comparisons use monthly data where available.

challenges.text: Source catalog lacks ids for China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, General Administration of Customs (GACC) and Customs Tariff Commission; add them before r2 so 17B leads can carry catalog ids.

X10 combines trade, connectivity and border operations; suggest splitting into (a) border-point operating status/disruption events and (b) announced connectivity projects, because they carry different evidence standards (operating record vs announcement).
Treat northern-route transit capacity as zero-by-default in baseline transit modelling until 17B supplies an operating record; announced routes are scenario options only.

uncertainty: Very high for r1: no China-specific primary document was located or retrieved. The instrument list itself is provisional (named from domain knowledge, flagged for verification) and could omit newer instruments signed in 2025-2026. Border trade values and disruption durations are unknown.
